Check three saved Louisiana contractor license records each morning and alert if a source changes.

your_steps.title: set up your apify account and deploy both actors
your_steps.detail: Open the Apify account page and complete developer and payout setup yourself; Glacier does not create the account or verify your identity. Install Apify's upload tool, then from the repository root run `npm exec --yes --package=apify-cli@1.10.0 -- apify login`. Upload both prepared Actors with `(cd ventures/apify-tools && npm exec --yes --package=apify-cli@1.10.0 -- apify push)` and `(cd ventures/apify-tools-louisiana && npm exec --yes --package=apify-cli@1.10.0 -- apify push)`. Keep sign-in details inside Apify; do not paste them into Glacier.

your_steps.title: review and publish each listing
your_steps.detail: For each of the first three distinct Actor publications, run a separate Glacier publication approval. Have a different engine review that Actor's code and Store listing, confirm its event price, included platform usage and run limit, then publish it yourself. An earlier approval cannot cover another Actor. The Louisiana approval is not ready until its separate-engine review is recorded. Later publications are not blocked by the first-three approval gate.

product.purpose: Sell source-linked, pay-per-use checks of Mississippi and Louisiana contractor license status and expiration using each board's public lookup.
